content: नी €1 <ab>U.</ab> (नयति-ते, निनाय-निन्ये, अनैषीत्-अनेष्ट, नेष्यति-ते, नेतुम्, नीत) (One of the roots that govern two accusatives, see examples below) .²1 To carry, lead, bring, convey, take, conduct; अजां ग्रामं नयति <ls>Sk.</ls>; नय मां नवेन वसतिं पयोमुचा <ls>V. 4. 43</ls>. .²2 To guide, direct, govern; मूढः परप्रत्ययनेयबुद्धिः <ls>M. 1. 2</ls>. .²3 To lead away to, carry or bring away; सीता लङ्कां नीता सुरारिणा <ls>Bk. 6. 49</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 103</ls>; <ls>Ms. 6. 88</ls>. .²4 To carry off; <ls>Śānti. 3. 5</ls>. .²5 To carry off for oneself (<ab>Ātm.</ab>). .²6 To spend, or pass (as time); येनामन्दमरन्दे दलदरविन्दे दिनान्यनायिषत <ls>Bv. 1. 10</ls>; नीत्वा मासान् कतिचित् <ls>Me. 2</ls>; संविष्टः कुशशयने निशां निनाय <ls>R. 1. 95</ls>. .²7 To bring or reduce any person to any state or condition; तमपि तरलतामनयदनङ्गः <ls>K. 143</ls>; नीतस्त्वया पञ्चताम् <ls>Ratn. 3. 3</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 19</ls>. (In this sense the root is used with substantives much in the same way as कृ <ab>q. v.</ab>); {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} दुःखं नी to reduce to misery; वशं नी to reduce to subjection, win over; अस्तं नी to cause to set; विनाशं नी to destroy; परितोषं नी to gratify, please; शूद्रतां-दासत्वं <ab>&c.</ab> नी to reduce to the state of a Śūdra, slave <ab>&c.</ab>; साक्ष्यं नी to admit as a witness; दण्डं नी to inflict punishment upon, to punish; पुनरुक्ततां नी to render superfluous; विक्रयं नी to sell; भस्मतां-भस्मसात् नी to reduce to ashes <ab>&c.</ab> .²8 To ascertain, investigate, inquire into, settle, decide; छलं निरस्य भूतेन व्यवहारान्नयेन्नृपः <ls>Y. 2. 19</ls>; एवं शास्त्रेषु भिन्नेषु बहुधा नीयते क्रिया <ls>Mb.</ls> .²9 To trace, track, find out; एतैर्लिङ्गैर्नयेत् सीमाम् <ls>Ms. 8. 252</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 8.">256</ls>; यथा नयत्यसृक्पातैर्मृगस्य मृगयुः पदम् <ls n="Ms.">8. 44</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 151</ls>. .²10 To marry. .²11 To exclude from. .²12 (<ab>Ātm.</ab>) To instruct, give instruction in; शास्त्रे नयते <ls>Sk.</ls> --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (नाययति-ते) To cause to lead, carry <ab>&c.</ab> (with <ab>instr.</ab> of agent); तेन मां सरस्तीरमनाययत् <ls>K. 38</ls>. --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (निनीषति-ते) To wish to carry <ab>&c.</ab>
नी {%m.%} (Used at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) A leader, guide; as in ग्रामणी, सेनानी, अग्रणी.
